title: Algebraic local lifts of finite constant derived maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $B$ a finite commutative ring, and $E,G$ bounded cochain complexes of finite $B$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For every etale object $V\to X$ and every morphism $\alpha$ in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] between the restrictions of the termwise constant realizations of $E,G$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf], there is a covering sieve of $V$ on each member $W\to V$ of which $\alpha|_W$ is the restriction of the constant realization of a morphism $E\to G$ in $D(B)$. Restriction is the one in [def-weil-pbc-etale-derived-map-presheaves].

source.place: Tag 09BE, lemma-locally-constant-map; finite-source extension using Tag 08FR

proof.text: Finite terms give finite homology. A finite ring is Noetherian, so E is pseudo-coherent by the cohomology criterion. Obtain a bounded finite free approximation P to E inducing isomorphisms above m, with m two below a lower bound of G. The homology sequence makes its cone lie in degrees at most m.
Orthogonality and the exact Hom sequences of the approximation triangle and its inverse rotation identify maps E to G with maps P to G.

Constants preserve finite limits and finite colimits by the existing preservesFiniteLimits_constantSheaf and preservesFiniteColimits_constantSheaf instances: constant presheaves preserve these pointwise, and sheafification is left exact and left adjoint. Exact inverse image and the exact-functor derived API preserve the triangle and its cohomological bounds. Applying the same Hom comparison gives the restricted bijection.

Local-actual represents maps from constant P by actual chain maps on an etale cover. Descend the finitely many components algebraically on a further covering sieve. Lift the algebraic class through the approximation bijection; injectivity of the restricted approximation bijection identifies its realization with the original morphism.

Use the constant inverse-image comparison on V. Form the image sieve of the constant algebraic Hom presheaf map. The pointwise local lifts just obtained show its arrows jointly cover V, hence it is a covering sieve.

theorem finiteRing_constant_derived_map_local
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (E G : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) ℤ)
    (hE : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n))
    (hG : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hEfin : ∀ n : ℤ, Finite (E.X n)) (_hGfin : ∀ n : ℤ, Finite (G.X n))
    (V : X.Etale)
    (α : (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) V.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E)) ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) V.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))) :
    ∃ S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology V, ∀ (W : X.Etale) (f : W ⟶ V), S f →
      ∃ a : DerivedCategory.Q.obj E ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G,
        restrictDerivedMap B f α =
          (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) W.hom).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapDerivedCategory.map
              a)
